newIllustrations.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new landscape-format fantasy world guide illustration, 1536 by 1024. DVERGHAMAR has high gravity, permanent twilight, homes excavated within rock and water-powered industry. Show a close monumental weathered rock escarpment taking up most of the frame, broad low buttresses, layered rock, deeply recessed occupied doorways and small warm windows. A narrow engineered spillway drops past a large practical waterwheel driving visible shafts into rock workshops. A few modest planted benches catch the fixed low sun; sparse vegetation, no grassy alpine slopes. A distant band of low orange daylight cuts across wet stone while the upper cliffs remain dark slate and charcoal. Use clear planes, strong chiaroscuro and tactile gouache or oil-like brushwork, detailed believable civil engineering without presenting a technical diagram. View obliquely from a nearby rock ledge rather than down a scenic river valley. This is an inhabited, weighty mineral world, not an abandoned fortress. Building details are an artistic interpretation of an unnamed district. No giant trees, fairy castles, crystal spires, pastoral European villages, pointed snowy alpine panorama, glowing magic runes, lava spectacle, extra suns, giant moon, labels or text. No large figures requiring invented anatomy.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a new landscape-format fantasy world guide illustration, 1536 by 1024. Inhabited wooden sailing boats, a modest floating platform with useful goods, woven moorings, and walkways among root-grown dwellings show a working maritime community. Diverse native plantlike forms, not precise named Earth species. Muted emerald, blue-green water, ivory sails, filtered daylight and humid air; rich layered painterly illustration, thoughtful natural detail. Horizontal open channels, reflections and roots make the scene feel fundamentally different from a mountain world. This is an unnamed illustrative coast, not Dorrenath and not a fixed geographic map. No mountains, stone castles, alpine river valley, medieval European street, crystal towers, giant moon filling the sky, permanent sunset, luminous portal, text or labels. People, if present, are tiny background sailors with no invented close-up biological features.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape-format fantasy world guide illustration, 1536 by 1024, of DORRENATH, the eldest Wayroot on Merenval. Accepted scale: twenty-five kilometres tall, with an exceptionally broad crown; exact crown diameter and site are deliberately unspecified. A living tree of landscape scale, not a mountain carved into a tree and not a normal tree beside miniature houses. Distant aerial viewpoint from above a layer of ordinary low cloud reveals her enormous broad, irregular, multileveled crown and strongly branching living trunk. Multiple thin cloud decks cross far below the upper canopy, and a carpet of ordinary forest at ground level is almost too small to resolve. Her branches span above lower clouds. Her biological form and bark texture are an artistic interpretation; exact location, canopy width, and internal anatomy must not be encoded as a measured diagram. Deep forest green, slate blue atmospheric distance, pearl clouds, high clear sunlight, monumental but calm painterly landscape. Avoid red-oak-specific leaf closeups, literal World Tree supporting planets, cosmic symbols, portals, exaggerated galaxy sky, tapering Christmas-tree shape, isolated enormous mushroom cap, dense medieval castles, waterfalls taller than mountains, labels or text.
